summary: BOXABL Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $100,000,000 of Class A common stock under a September 25, 2026 ATM Sales Agreement with Virtu Americas, A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, Cohen Company Capital Markets, Maxim Group and Roth Capital Partners as sales agents. Shares trade on Nasdaq under BXBL; agents receive up to 3.0% commission and use commercially reasonable efforts with no escrow. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution, sales pace and any price floors rather than deal terms.
